transcript: Two of the most important things that I've learned is not to judge myself and to be in a state of movements. Those things are scary and I've learned the less I judge myself, the easier it is for me to move. Movement can shift you through timelines, movement can shift you through seasons. Whenever I feel like I'm stuck, it's because I'm judging myself or something. Leaning into movement, I am reminded that I am not stuck. I have the ability to get up and move.
